overview_description.description:
Serviis is a marketplace connecting professionals and small and medium companies with customers across more than 100 services, including home services, wellness, fitness, tutoring, business services,  and more
Professionals and SMEs can register , build their online profiles and then start bidding on projects by using their own credits. Credits can be bought or received for referrals
